run_make_changelog: run the make_changelog script to collect changelog entries from closed GitHub issues with the needs changelog label
extract_changelog_entries: extract RST-formatted changelog entries from GitHub issue bodies using the ENTRY regex pattern
list_missing_changelogs: list closed GitHub issues that are missing a suggested changelog entry and print a template
format_changelog_with_rich: format and print changelog entries with RST syntax highlighting using the rich library
query_github_issues: query the pybind11 GitHub repository for closed issues labeled needs changelog using ghapi
